brief: The canvas displays a continuous, dynamic abstract composition composed entirely of bold, intersecting bands of color. These geometrical bands perpetually shift, warp, and reconfigure across the surface. The movement is relentless and fluid, creating a perpetually changing sense of depth and structure. The color palette cycles through vibrant hues, maintaining a distinct, retro aesthetic, while the defining visual feature is the sharp geometry: the bands transition sharply from one state to the next, defined by hard, angular corners rather than soft curves or smooth gradients.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, abstract composition using geometric bands that continuously shift and reconfigure across the canvas. The bands are defined by sharp angular polygons that morph in real-time through sinusoidal distortion effects, creating an ever-changing sense of depth and structure. Each band moves independently with its own rotation speed and color hue, cycling through a vibrant retro palette. The composition maintains a bold, high-contrast aesthetic while delivering fluid motion that keeps the viewer engaged without any external input or user interaction.
